composition_label: Adaptive onboarding -> Semantic search -> Interest-based recommendations

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory; no other builds or repository files read or copied.

input.fixture_label: Nonblank fixture provenance string. Bundled data is explicitly SYNTHETIC.

profile.interests: Unique nonblank strings; used as fallback query and recommendation concepts.
profile.preferences: Map from category/tag phrases to finite weights in [0, 1].
profile.excluded_ids: Unique product IDs; exact case-sensitive matching.
profile.completed_lessons: Unique basics/search/compare lessons; prerequisite closure required.

input.query: String; blank query falls back to interests, then to explicit browsing.
input.catalog: At most 1000 products with unique id, name, description, category, tags, min_experience and required_lessons.

output.success: status=ok plus shared envelope: schema_version, stage=interests, context, onboarding, search, recommendations.
output.context: Validated deep copy of the request, shared through all stages.
output.onboarding: experience, effective search_query and prerequisite-ordered steps with explanations.
output.ranked_rows: Search and recommendation rows contain id, finite score in [0,1], and nonempty explanations.
output.error: Single JSON object with status=error and error message; exit code 2.

shared_schema.validation: One validation layer with reusable type/range helpers, validate_request and validate_envelope. Both sides of every handoff validate schema, stage order, eligibility, result provenance, uniqueness, threshold and ranking. Unknown fields and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated envelope containing effective query, profile, exclusions, weighted preferences, completed prerequisites and catalog. Semantic search reads the onboarding query, not a newly generated query.
Validated eligible search candidates with relevance scores plus unchanged context. Discovery can only rerank these candidates; it cannot introduce unseen or excluded products.

behavior.onboarding: Basics -> search -> compare prerequisite graph. Completed lessons are skipped. Preferences or expert experience add comparison guidance; explanations use experience/preferences. Plans do not mark lessons complete or unlock products.
behavior.semantic_search: Unicode word normalization, curated synonym concepts, eligible-product inverted index and IDF-weighted query coverage. Nonmatching products are omitted for nonblank concept queries; blank browsing starts at zero relevance.
behavior.optional_embeddings: Python-only injected callable accepting [query, document, ...], returning a batch of equal-dimensional nonzero finite numeric vectors. No provider loading from JSON. Cosine similarity is clamped to [0,1] and blended equally with lexical relevance. Shape, type, magnitude and callback failures are validated with synthetic fixtures.
behavior.interest_ranking: Normalized weighted mean: search weight 0.5, interest overlap weight 0.3 when interests exist, preference match weight 0.2 when positive preference weights exist. Matching uses category/tag concepts only.
behavior.exclusions: IDs, case-insensitive categories, experience and completed lesson prerequisites enforced before indexing and at every result handoff.
behavior.grounding: Search explanations name actual indexed concept matches or numeric injected similarity. Recommendations cite actual category/tag interest and preference matches and inherited relevance; absence of preference matches is stated.
behavior.determinism: Scores rounded to eight decimal places; descending score with ascending product ID ties; sorted query concepts and explanation matches. Injected callables must themselves be deterministic.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout. Success exit 0; argument, file, JSON and validation failures exit 2. No live services, filesystem writes or application logging during CLI execution.

included: Shared validated schema and stage envelopes
Synthetic fixtures and standard-library unittest coverage
CLI and optional fixture-tested embedding callable
excluded: Production authentication, user persistence or databases
Live models, networks, providers or external dependencies
Learned semantic models; built-in semantic matching is a bounded synonym baseline
scope.administrative_note: A separate docs\My_prompt.txt prompt audit log is retained to satisfy the enclosing environment's mandatory prompt-logging instruction; it is not a runtime deliverable.

coverage: Synonym search, threshold, empty/no-match/browse cases and deterministic ties
Embedding success, malformed vectors and callback failures
Preference reranking and grounded attribute explanations
Cross-stage query propagation, provenance and eligibility
Invalid schema, duplicate IDs, nonfinite values and corrupted handoffs
CLI success, usage, file, malformed JSON and validation errors
